Books kept close.

Each title will have its own page: the exact edition, why it is here, and a short review. Reading pages stay public. Downloads will ask for an email address.

Not yet published

No book is listed yet. A title appears here only after its edition and rights basis are confirmed in writing, and after a review has been written for it.

What a book page will show

Cover, title, translator or author, publisher and year, language, and the edition being discussed. Then the review, the rights line, and the choice between reading on the page and downloading.

Formats will be chosen per title. A readable HTML page comes first where the edition allows it, then EPUB, then PDF.
